changes: Synchronization lists the actual waiting journal IDs or saved request references, payroll months, employee/leave records and document titles as bullets, with expandable details.
Database-confirmed records are distinguished from pending edits, voids, voucher links and downloaded-data refreshes.
Unresolved sync notifications remain visible after being read. Device-only document, template, payroll, attendance, employee, leave and report saves no longer claim database success.
Retry keeps the original saved request and version safeguards; the sync window explains reconnection, conflicts, storage failures and recovery without re-entering records.
